question:
Two coaxial coils are placed close together. Coil 1 (primary) is connected to a DC battery through a switch and after a long time carries a steady current $I_0$. Coil 2 (secondary) is a closed loop with resistance $R$. The mutual inductance between the coils is $M$. 

Viewed from a chosen end, the steady current in coil 1 is clockwise, producing magnetic flux into the page through coil 2. At $t=0$, the switch is opened, so the current in coil 1 begins to decrease.

Determine the direction of the induced current in coil 2 immediately after opening the switch (as seen from the same end).

options.C: Zero, because the battery is disconnected
